Enumerate every discrete payment expressly stated in the current facts as a separate row, including oppositely directed payments. Within each clause preserve its own payer, one actual payee, literal payment wording, and numeric amount. Do not merge reciprocal payments or reuse another row's direction, service, amount, or period. Passive payment may have payer null. Wages establish a payment but do not establish cash, an annual-income event, or a payment date.
Read facts only. The host names each enumerated source row; do not generate an event ID. Do not infer missing dates, people or places. Complete scans enumerate every relevant source record. Ambiguity is unread. Return the named relation wrapper.

{"task": {"current_facts": "Over the year 2018, Alice has paid $2325 in hay to Bob for agricultural labor.", "actual_prior_source_records": {"observed_related_source_events": [{"component": "service_events", "facts": [{"predicate": "service_", "arguments": ["agricultural labor"]}, {"predicate": "agent_", "arguments": ["agricultural labor", "Bob"]}, {"predicate": "patient_", "arguments": ["agricultural labor", "Alice"]}, {"predicate": "purpose_", "arguments": ["agricultural labor", "agricultural labor"]}, {"predicate": "type_", "arguments": ["agricultural labor", "agricultural labor"]}]}]}, "requested_relation": "payment_core", "shared_key_domain": "observed_payment_event"}, "output_schema": {"type": "object", "properties": {"payment_core": {"anyOf": [{"type": "object", "properties": {"witnesses": {"type": "array", "minItems": 1, "items": {"type": "object", "properties": {"field": {"const": "facts"}, "quote": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1}}, "required": ["field", "quote"], "additionalProperties": false}}, "status": {"const": "complete"}, "records": {"type": "array", "items": {"type": "object", "properties": {"payment_term": {"type": "string"}, "payer": {"type": ["string", "null"]}, "payee": {"type": "string"}, "amount": {"type": ["number", "null"]}}, "required": ["payment_term", "payer", "payee", "amount"], "additionalProperties": false}}}, "required": ["witnesses", "status", "records"], "additionalProperties": false}, {"type": "object", "properties": {"witnesses": {"type": "array", "minItems": 1, "items": {"type": "object", "properties": {"field": {"const": "facts"}, "quote": {"type": "string", "minLength": 1}}, "required": ["field", "quote"], "additionalProperties": false}}, "status": {"const": "unread"}, "records": {"type": "null"}}, "required": ["witnesses", "status", "records"], "additionalProperties": false}]}}, "required": ["payment_core"], "additionalProperties": false}}
